name: xproof
description: Proof and accountability layer for AI agents. Anchor verifiable proofs on MultiversX, enforce pre-execution audit logging, detect violations on Base. No proof = no action.
author: jasonxkensei

tools.name: certify_file
tools.description: Anchor a file hash on MultiversX as immutable proof of existence and ownership. Records the SHA-256 hash on-chain with 6-second finality. Cost: $0.05 per proof.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the file (64 hex characters)

author_name.description: Name of the proof submitter (default: AI Agent)

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL for on-chain confirmation callback (signed HMAC-SHA256)

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Verify an existing xProof record. Returns proof details including file hash, timestamp, blockchain transaction, and verification status.

proof_id.description: UUID of the proof to verify

tools.name: batch_certify
tools.description: Anchor up to 50 file proofs in a single API call. Each file requires a SHA-256 hash and filename.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the file (64 hex characters)

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Retrieve a proof in structured JSON or Markdown format. Use JSON for machine processing, Markdown for LLM consumption.

format.description: Output format: json or md (default: json)

tools.name: discover_services
tools.description: Discover available xProof services, pricing, and capabilities. No authentication required.

tools.name: audit_agent_session
tools.description: Anchor an agent audit log on-chain BEFORE executing a critical action. The audit log captures agent identity, action intent, risk assessment, and decision. If this call fails or returns no proof_id, the agent MUST NOT proceed. This is the enforcement primitive for the Agent Audit Log Standard.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier for the agent (wallet address, DID, or free string)

action_type.description: Category of action (e.g. trade, deploy, data_access, transfer, api_call)

action_description.description: Human-readable description of what the agent intends to do

inputs_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the action inputs (deterministic, hex, 64 chars)

decision.description: Agent's decision on whether to proceed
